title: Kneaded Pillowy Japanese Pork Donburi
description: A low-carb Japanese dish featuring tender pork and earthy flavors, served over a bed of cauliflower rice in a donburi style bowl.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sesame oil to make the marinade.
Add the pork pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Let the pork marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Remove the pork from the marinade and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cauliflower rice to the skillet and cook until tender.
To assemble the donburi, place a scoop of cauliflower rice in a bowl, followed by a portion of the pork.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
